notes:
- New unfinished **View Template Snapshot** tool exports reusable view-template settings to JSON and imports them into a view, its active template, or a selected template
- Snapshots include template parameters, visibility/graphics overrides, imported CAD layers, filters, and supported Revit link settings, with a pre-import comparison and a report of skipped project content
- New unfinished **CAD Layer Filter** tool saves reusable CAD layer rules and applies staged Visibility/Graphics overrides through an editable preview
- New **Project Tab Colors** settings let you colour Revit document tabs by project, with configurable colours and enabled state stored in Preferences
- **Match Sheet Positions** now aligns crop regions with their mapped viewports and presents mappings in a predictable order
- **Batch Link Files** handles imported CAD and cloud CAD links more reliably
- **Find & Replace** has clearer, selectable preview rows and better preview columns
